assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are provisional rough geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: Recalculate every area, ratio, land-use partition, node and drawing after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, heritage controls, utilities, fire access, flood and engineering constraints are absent.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, demolition, road engineering, investment and permission decisions remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: Three building footprints are adaptive-reuse concept envelopes, not surveyed buildings or approved construction footprints.
The human scenario committee, operators and service desks are proposed governance roles without confirmed institutional commitments.
assumptions.impact: Phase 0 must name accountable operators, resources, permissions and stop authority.

assumptions.statement: Service quality, accessibility, energy, cost, satisfaction and incident metrics have no observed field baseline.
assumptions.impact: They remain unknown until audited pilots establish definitions and samples.

assumptions.statement: This revision uses public desk research and has not completed site survey or stakeholder interviews.
assumptions.impact: Observational and community claims are excluded; field work remains a prerequisite.

assumptions.statement: The six stitches, nine component types and three station plans are agent-generated spatial design objects under provisional boundaries, not surveyed or approved engineering geometry.
assumptions.impact: Their counts and internal references are reproducible, but their position, dimensions and delivery feasibility must be recalculated after official base maps, utilities, ownership and field audits are available.

assumptions.statement: V7 S7 local dimensions, directional entrances, curbs, public cross, transit interface, trial bay, evidence porch and kit quantities are prototype design assumptions rather than surveyed conditions.
assumptions.impact: Every dimension, interface, quantity and quote requires survey and professional review before E2.
assumptions.verification_method: Licensed survey, utility detection, official station-exit and road-line information, accessibility/fire/traffic review, prototype measurement and formal supplier quotations.

assumptions.statement: Verification Ring, Translation Gate and Receipt Porch are conceptual civic landmark prototypes under provisional boundaries, not approved buildings or installed public art.
assumptions.impact: Location, structure, heritage review, fire access, utilities, ownership and accessibility require professional verification before E2.

assumptions.statement: The four-season civic year and 90-day S7 pilot are proposed operating protocols, not confirmed calendars, staffing commitments or permits.
assumptions.impact: Phase dates, duty rosters, insurance, procurement, data governance and public representation must be agreed before field use.

statement.zh: E2 仅表示原型准备文件完整；测绘、许可、报价、搭建和现场运行仍待完成。
statement.en: E2 means prototype-preparation documents are complete; survey, permits, quotes, assembly and field operation remain pending.

consequence.zh: 不得把空白表单、构件数量或数字样机解读为现场绩效。
consequence.en: Blank forms, quantities and the digital prototype must not be read as field performance.

statement.zh: 84 项确定性桌面演练只验证规则、状态跃迁、准入、停止、恢复和退役契约自洽，不是现场仿真、公众测试或安全认证。
statement.en: The 84 deterministic tabletop cases verify only rule, transition, admission, stop, recovery and retirement consistency; they are not field simulation, public testing or safety certification.

impact.zh: 客流、效率、安全表现、满意度、能耗、成本和恢复时长继续保持现场未知。
impact.en: Flow, efficiency, safety performance, satisfaction, energy, cost and recovery duration remain field unknowns.

assumptions.statement: V11 alternative dimensions and distances are design-model assumptions in a local metre projection, not surveyed site dimensions.
assumptions.impact: Rerun the spatial audit after official base mapping, station entrance, fire, accessibility and utility data are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: All three alternatives use the same provisional Dazhongsi context and do not assert official ownership, redlines or station entrances.
assumptions.impact: A change in the verified context may change the reject, revise or advance result.

statement.zh: 12人容量、2.28 FTE、ROM比例、关键依赖和验收拆分是参与者侧预可行性假设，不是批准容量、人员承诺、正式概算或现场结果。
statement.en: The 12-person cap, 2.28 FTE, ROM allowances, critical path and acceptance split are participant-side pre-feasibility assumptions, not approved capacity, staffing commitments, a formal estimate or field results.

impact.zh: 完成测绘、运营主体确认、专业复核和正式询价后必须重算并由相应责任方签署。
impact.en: They must be recalculated and signed by accountable parties after survey, operator confirmation, professional review and formal quotations.
